WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT timestamp, value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND station_name = 'ced_maintenance'
    AND metric_name = 'maint_nozzle_cleaning_time'
),
 
baseline AS (
  SELECT mean, std_dev
  FROM baseline_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_maintenance'
    AND metric_name = 'maint_nozzle_cleaning_time'
  LIMIT 1
)
 
SELECT
  f.timestamp AS time,
  f.value AS "value",
 
  (b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev) AS "UCL (+3σ)",
  (b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev) AS "LCL (-3σ)",
  b.mean AS "Mean",
 
  CASE
    WHEN f.value > (b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev)
      OR f.value < (b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev)
    THEN f.value
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Anomaly"
 
FROM filtered f
CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY f.timestamp;
